stories.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature 2026
stories.body: the Swedish Academy announced TODAY (8 Oct, 4:30 PM IST) that Canadian poet, essayist and classical scholar Anne Carson (76) is this year's Literature laureate, "for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature." Carson — born in Toronto, a classical philologist trained at the University of Toronto — is celebrated for genre-defying works such as Autobiography of Red (1998) and Nox, alongside her translations of Greek classics. She is the second Canadian laureate after Alice Munro (2013) and only the 20th woman among 122 laureates; the prize was announced by Academy permanent secretary Ingrid Carlberg. This is the fourth Nobel of 2026. Already announced this week: Medicine (5 Oct) — Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for light-gated ion channels/optogenetics; Physics (6 Oct) — Francis Halzen for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and high-energy astrophysical neutrinos; Chemistry (7 Oct) — Henri B. Kagan (France) and Kenso Soai (Japan) for non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. Still to come: Peace (9 Oct, Norwegian Nobel Committee, 2:30 PM IST) and Economic Sciences (12 Oct). Prize money: 12 million Swedish kronor (~US$1.2 million).

stories.title: RBI raises repo rate to 5.5% — first hike in nearly 4 years
stories.body: the Reserve Bank of India on 7 October raised the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023, citing inflation that is "no longer benign". The 6-member MPC (met 5–7 Oct in Mumbai) voted unanimously for the hike and shifted the stance from "neutral" to "calibrated tightening" (4–2 majority), ruling out rate cuts in the near term. SDF rate adjusted to 5.25%, MSF rate and Bank Rate to 5.75%. Drivers: August CPI inflation at 4.82% (third month above the 4% target), West Asia escalation pushing crude to ~US$114–116/barrel, and a 13% southwest-monsoon deficit + El Niño lifting food prices. FY27 inflation forecast raised to 5.2%; GDP forecast raised to 7.1% (Q1 grew 7.8%). Governor: Sanjay Malhotra.

stories.title: SAREX-2026: mass SAR demo off Paradip coast TODAY (8 Oct)
stories.body: the 12th National Maritime Search & Rescue Exercise (SAREX-2026) was inaugurated on 7 October by Raksha Rajya Mantri Sanjay Seth; the main search-and-rescue demonstration runs today (8 Oct) off the Paradip coast, organised by the Indian Coast Guard — one of the region's largest, most complex SAR drills. 32 observers from 30 countries are attending. Assets: 15 ICG ships, 2 Dornier aircraft, 3 Advanced Light Helicopters, 1 Chetak, IAF C-130J & Mi-17, 2 Indian Navy ships, plus civil/state assets. The drill simulates a mass rescue operation — a passenger aircraft ditching at sea with 228 persons on board, colliding with container vessel MV Zumba. Alongside, the 24th NMSAR Board Meeting meets at Bhubaneswar under DG ICG Paramesh Sivamani, aligned with the SAGAR / MAHASAGAR vision.

stories.title: 72nd BPSC Prelims postponed AGAIN — will not be held on 25 Oct
stories.body: the Bihar Public Service Commission has postponed the 72nd Combined (Preliminary) Competitive Examination, previously scheduled for 25 October 2026, for the second time (it was first moved from 26 July). No fresh date has been announced; the October date was only tentative in the revised exam calendar, and the commission is expected to notify the revised schedule on bpsc.bihar.gov.in separately. The drive fills roughly 1,186 posts (SDO, DSP and allied Bihar government services); selection is through prelims (objective screening) → mains → interview.

stories.title: Jaishankar in Ghana; India–Ghana exchange 2 MoUs
stories.body: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar arrived in Accra on 6 October on the first leg of a three-nation Africa tour (Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia), meeting Ghana's Foreign Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa and President John Dramani Mahama. The two sides exchanged 2 MoUs: Zoological Survey of India ↔ University of Ghana (academics, scientific research, capacity building) and ICAR ↔ Ghana's CSIR-Crops Research Institute (agricultural research & education). Talks covered the Comprehensive Partnership in trade, pharma, defence, technology and people-to-people ties, plus multilateral cooperation and India's engagement with the African Union and ECOWAS (15-member Economic Community of West African States; Ghana a founding member). Ties were elevated to Comprehensive Partnership during PM Modi's 2025 state visit.

stories.title: IISc's Mahesh Kakde wins Ramanujan Prize 2026
stories.body: Mahesh Kakde, professor of mathematics at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, has been awarded the Ramanujan Prize 2026 for Young Mathematicians from Developing Countries, jointly given by the International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP) and the International Mathematical Union (IMU). The $10,000 prize recognises researchers under 45 working in developing countries; Kakde was honoured for algebraic number theory — fundamental results in noncommutative Iwasawa theory and the Gross-Stark & Brumer-Stark conjectures, with implications for Hilbert's 12th problem (one of David Hilbert's 23 problems of 1900). Earlier honours: Infosys Prize in Mathematical Sciences (2022).

stories.title: PM Modi inaugurates India Mobile Congress today (8 Oct)
stories.body: the 10th India Mobile Congress (7–10 Oct, Yashobhoomi, New Delhi; theme "Scale Without Boundaries", by DoT + COAI) sees PM Narendra Modi inaugurate the event today on its second day. Built on four pillars — Srishti, Samvardhan, Sashakt, Suraksha — the congress hosts 1.5 lakh+ attendees, 300+ exhibitors from 100+ countries and 1,500+ tech use cases, spanning 6G, AI, satcom, semiconductors, quantum and cybersecurity.

stories.title: World Bank: India among top-10 emerging-market AI performers
stories.body: a World Bank report, "India and Artificial Intelligence: Seizing the Development Opportunity", ranks India among the top 10 emerging-market performers in AI readiness, citing technical talent, digital public infrastructure and a strong IT ecosystem. Private AI investment in India rose from US$1.2 billion (2024) to US$4.1 billion (2025); about 23% of Indian firms report using AI.

stories.title: INDIA bloc MPs to stage another protest against CEC today (8 Oct)
stories.body: a day after Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi's detention during the march toward the Election Commission over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, opposition MPs plan another protest today, continuing their demand for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Meanwhile the Supreme Court has agreed to examine a plea to recall its 23 September split verdict on the law governing CEC/EC appointments; the matter was mentioned before CJI Surya Kant.

stories.title: Five-storey building collapse in Delhi's Seemapuri (7 Oct)
stories.body: a five-storey residential building collapsed in New Seemapuri, Delhi on 7 October, killing one person and injuring eight others; rescue teams from the Delhi Fire Service, NDRF, police and civic authorities searched the debris for the trapped, including a pregnant woman and children.

stories.title: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit appointed 29th Chief of the Air Staff
stories.body: the government has appointed Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, currently Vice Chief of the Air Staff, as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff in the rank of Air Chief Marshal; he takes charge on the afternoon of 31 October 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh, who superannuates the same day. Commissioned into the fighter stream on 6 December 1986, Dixit has logged 3,500+ flying hours (Mirage 2000, MiG variants, Jaguar, Tejas) and is an experimental test pilot; operational experience includes Op Safed Sagar, Op Rakshak and Op Sindoor; honours include the PVSM, AVSM, VM and VSM.

stories.title: MoD signs Rs 661.50 crore BrahMos contract (6 Oct)
stories.body: the Ministry of Defence signed a Rs 661.50 crore contract with BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited (BAPL) for BrahMos fire control systems and launchers for Indian Navy ships, under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category, in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. The contract mandates a minimum 68% indigenous content, with MSME participation, and is expected to generate employment over three years; BrahMos is the Navy's primary surface-to-surface missile system for maritime strike.

stories.title: Cabinet approves Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund (SGF)
stories.body: the Union Cabinet (chaired by PM Modi, 6 Oct) approved a Rs 10,000 crore commitment to set up the SME Growth Fund as an Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) for direct equity investment in small and medium enterprises — "to create future champions". Announced in the Union Budget 2026-27, the fund targets the gap in long-term growth equity for SMEs; a majority of the allocation will go to small and medium manufacturing enterprises, including clusters in Tier-II/III cities.

stories.title: Cabinet approves Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA)
stories.body: the Union Cabinet (6 Oct) approved setting up ITLA as a Special Purpose Vehicle — the national apex body for integrated transport planning, research, project appraisal, monitoring and impact assessment across roads, railways, ports & shipping, civil aviation, inland waterways, coastal shipping, urban mobility and logistics. It will undertake technical appraisal and monitor implementation of government infra projects costing Rs 500 crore or more, complementing (not replacing) the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan; announcement by Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw.

stories.title: WWF Living Planet Report 2026: wildlife populations down 73% since 1970
stories.body: the Living Planet Report 2026, released on 8 October, finds the average size of monitored wildlife populations fell 73% between 1970 and 2022 (~2.5% per year). The Living Planet Index (by the Zoological Society of London + WWF) tracked 35,803 populations of 5,790 vertebrate species; declines were steepest in freshwater species (−85%), followed by terrestrial (−69%) and marine (−59%); regionally South America −95% and Africa −80%. Main threat: habitat loss and degradation, followed by overexploitation and climate change.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh declares drought in 21 of 26 districts
stories.body: the state government (GO issued 1 Oct) declared 388 of 688 mandals drought-affected for Kharif 2026 — 283 severely and 105 moderately affected — after a 53.4% rainfall deficit (June–August) and prevailing El Niño conditions. The Committee on Drought recommended the early declaration (ahead of the 31 Oct deadline); worst hit: the Rayalaseema region. Follows similar declarations by Karnataka and Maharashtra for the 2026 southwest monsoon.

stories.title: Pramod Bhagat & Bhavina Patel named flag bearers for Asian Para Games 2026
stories.body: Paralympic champions Pramod Bhagat (para badminton) and Bhavina Patel (para table tennis) will lead the Indian contingent at the opening ceremony of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games on 18 October in Nagoya, Japan. The 5th Asian Para Games run 18–24 October 2026; Bhagat has 6 APG medals (2014–2023, 2 golds) and Patel 2 APG medals (2018–2023, 1 silver). Selection announced by the Paralympic Committee of India (PCI); send-off ceremony in New Delhi on 8 October with Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya.
